plan_title: CapturePoint LLC Wellman Field Subpart RR Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) Plan
ama_definition: A half-mile buffer around the Wolfcamp Reef storage area boundary, where the plume is expected to stay (p18).
mma_definition: Same as the AMA: the stabilized plume area plus a half-mile buffer (p18).
leakage_pathways_rated_significant: Wellbores and surface equipment are treated as the only meaningful pathways; faults, seismicity, lateral migration and diffuse seal leakage are rated low risk (p20, p22-27).
baseline_summary: No pre-injection environmental baseline. The baseline is ongoing operational data (injection/production performance, inspections, H2S alarms) used to flag excursions (p33-34).
reporting_summary: Annual Subpart RR report with the mass balance and estimated leakage; records kept at least three years. No commitment to publish measurement data (p33-34, p39).

rows.detail: Custody transfer meter on CO2 received from the Trinity pipeline and operations meters on injected and recycled CO2; composition sampled at least quarterly.
rows.location: Custody transfer point and central tank battery
rows.evidence_quote: This meter measures flow rate continually.

rows.detail: Injection pressure and rate monitored against weekly pattern injection plans; SCADA monitors wellhead pressure; excursions flagged and screened for leakage.
rows.trigger_or_response: Pressure or rate outside pattern set points: field personnel investigate; unresolved issues get detailed investigation.
rows.evidence_quote: Pressure in injection wells is monitored daily.

rows.detail: Annular pressure in wellheads monitored to detect tubing and casing leaks.
rows.trigger_or_response: Anomaly: inspect; well shut in and workover crew responds within days if needed.
rows.evidence_quote: monitoring of the annular pressure in wellheads

rows.detail: MITs under Texas rule 3.46, every five years, to verify well and wellhead can hold operating pressure.
rows.trigger_or_response: Failed MIT: well isolated and leak mitigated.
rows.evidence_quote: Mechanical integrity tests (MIT), required under TAC Rule §3.46 [40 CFR §146.23 (b)(3)], will take place every five years

rows.detail: Each producer tested about monthly through test vessels (12-24 hours); produced gas metered and sampled annually for CO2; performance compared with forecast.
rows.location: Each production well; central production battery
rows.trigger_or_response: Significant deviation from forecast: well management personnel investigate.
rows.evidence_quote: each well being tested approximately once every month

rows.detail: Plan says reservoir pressure is continuously monitored and routinely updated to manage injection below fracture pressure; it does not say by which instruments or wells.
rows.trigger_or_response: Unexplained pressure changes trigger investigation; radioactive tracer survey if seal leakage suspected.
rows.evidence_quote: Reservoir pressure is continuously monitored and unexplained changes in reservoir pressure that might indicate leakage would trigger investigation

rows.detail: Routine field inspections of wells, facilities and abandoned well locations, looking for white CO2 clouds, ice and fluid leaks.
rows.trigger_or_response: Leak found: repair on the spot or shut in, work order, quantify.
rows.evidence_quote: Field inspections are conducted on a routine basis by field personnel.

rows.detail: All field personnel wear H2S monitors (alarm at 10 ppm); H2S is used as a proxy for CO2 leaks.
rows.trigger_or_response: Alarm: protect personnel, investigate source, quantify CO2 leak for the annual report.
rows.evidence_quote: the H2S monitors, which are always worn by all field personnel are used as a last method to detect leakage from wellbores.

rows.detail: Injection radioactive tracer survey if a reservoir pressure anomaly suggests diffuse leakage through the seal.
rows.trigger_or_response: Unexplained reservoir pressure change: tracer survey; if verified, shut in and workover.
rows.evidence_quote: Conduct an injection radioactive tracer survey.

rows.detail: Watches the public USGS earthquake monitoring site for seismic signals that could indicate new leakage pathways; also a one-time USGS catalog review. No site seismometers.
rows.trigger_or_response: Response plan lists shutting in injectors near a seismic event.
rows.evidence_quote: CapturePoint monitors the USGS earthquake monitoring Geological Information System site3 for seismic signals

rows.detail: Past seismic evaluation cited as ruling out faults; no repeat seismic.
rows.evidence_quote: Seismic evaluation has eliminated the existence of faults.

rows.detail: Subpart W emission factors and engineering estimates used to quantify surface equipment leaks and vents; emergency vent volume metered.
rows.evidence_quote: CapturePoint uses 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart W to estimate surface leaks from equipment at the WF.

notes: The plan says reservoir pressure is 'continuously monitored' but names no observation wells or gauges; it may mean pressures measured at injector headers (p28).
